title: Atomic Pointer Swap
goal: Atomically replace a raw pointer inside an AtomicPtr and retrieve the previous pointer.
hints: Convert references to mutable raw pointers using explicit pointer casting.
Use the atomic operation that returns the previous pointer value while storing a new one.
explanation: `val as *mut i32` turns the exclusive borrow into the raw pointer `AtomicPtr` stores, and `swap` writes the new pointer while handing back the old one. `*val` dereferences to an `i32`, which is not a pointer at all. `store` returns nothing, so the function has no value to give back, and `load` ignores the pointer you pass it.
